items.exampleEn: The twins wore identical jackets to the party.
items.exampleZh: 那對雙胞胎穿著一模一樣的外套去參加派對。

items.exampleEn: This information is readily available online.
items.exampleZh: 這些資訊在網路上很容易取得。

items.exampleEn: Please get off through the rear door of the bus.
The new shoes were stiff, so they hurt my feet at first.
items.exampleZh: 新鞋子很硬，所以一開始穿得腳很痛。

items.exampleEn: Thanks to the improved road, the trip now takes only an hour.
items.exampleZh: 多虧道路改善了，這趟路現在只要一小時。

items.exampleEn: In many Asian cultures, the color red is symbolic of good luck.
items.exampleZh: 在許多亞洲文化中，紅色象徵好運。

items.exampleEn: The beef was so tender that it melted in my mouth.
This plastic ruler is flexible, so it won't break easily.
items.exampleZh: 這把塑膠尺可以彎曲，所以不容易斷。

items.sentenceEn: Passengers with large bags should use the rear entrance.
items.sentenceZh: 帶大件行李的乘客請使用後方入口。

items.audioEn: The two contracts look identical, but the second one has a different date.
items.audioZh: 這兩份合約看起來一模一樣，但第二份的日期不同。

items.sentenceEn: She spoke to the frightened child in a tender voice.
items.sentenceZh: 她用溫柔的聲音對那個受驚的孩子說話。

items.sentenceEn: If your schedule is flexible, you can choose a cheaper flight.
items.sentenceZh: 如果你的時間安排有彈性，就能選比較便宜的班機。

items.stemEn: After the long flight, my legs felt ____ and hard to move.
items.stemZh: 長途飛行之後，我的腿覺得很僵硬，很難活動。

items.stemEn: The new bridge is ____ of the friendship between the two towns.
items.stemZh: 這座新橋象徵兩個城鎮之間的友誼。

items.passageEn: The company's new family car looks almost identical to last year's model, but it has many improved features. The rear seats are wider, so three adults can sit comfortably. The seats are no longer stiff; they are soft and flexible, and they can be moved easily. Every buyer also gets a small gift: a silver key ring, which is symbolic of the company's sixty years in business. Spare parts are readily available at any of the company's shops, and their prices are affordable. Many experts say this is the company's best car yet.
items.passageZh: 這家公司的新款家庭用車看起來和去年的車型幾乎一模一樣，但有許多改良過的功能。後座比較寬，三個大人可以坐得很舒服。座椅不再硬梆梆的，而是柔軟又有彈性，可以輕鬆調整。每位買主還會得到一份小禮物：一個銀色鑰匙圈，象徵公司經營六十年。在公司的任何一家門市都很容易買到備用零件，價格也負擔得起。許多專家說，這是這家公司到目前為止最好的車。

questions.questionZh: 新車的後座有什麼改變？
options: 可以完全摺平，放進更多行李
加裝了小冰箱和兩個螢幕
比較寬，三個大人坐得舒服

questions.questionZh: 那個銀色鑰匙圈象徵什麼？

items.promptZh: 這兩支手機看起來一模一樣，但價格不同。
referenceEn: These two phones look identical, but their prices are different.
The two phones look identical, but they have different prices.
rubricZh: identical 表示「完全相同的」，可放在 look、be 後面（例如 look identical）
「但價格不同」可寫 but their prices are different、but they cost different amounts 等

items.promptZh: 她很爽快地接受了我們的晚餐邀請。
referenceEn: She readily accepted our invitation to dinner.
She accepted our dinner invitation very readily.
rubricZh: readily 表示「樂意地、爽快地」，可放動詞前或句尾（例如 readily accepted 等）
「晚餐邀請」可寫，例如 our invitation to dinner、our dinner invitation 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式
